name: PokerFace · a player's turn at a no-limit Texas hold'em table

street.desc: The betting round: before the flop, or with three, four or five community cards out

position.desc: Where the player acts in this round: among the first (early), the middle, or the last (late, the button among them); blinds before the flop
position.from: the table, relative to the button

hole.desc: The player's two hole cards, rank then suit (Ah, Td)

board.desc: The community cards out so far, in the same notation

hand.desc: The hole cards' class: premium (AA, KK, QQ, AKs), strong (JJ, TT, AK, AQs, AJs, KQs), medium (99 to 77, AQ, AJ, ATs, KQ, KJs, QJs, JTs), speculative (small pairs, suited connectors, suited aces) or weak (the rest)
hand.from: the deal, classed by the app

made_hand.desc: The best five-card hand the player holds now, from the hole cards and the board

flush_draw.desc: Four cards to a flush, with cards still to come

straight_draw.desc: A straight draw with cards still to come: none, a gutshot (four outs) or open-ended (eight outs)

equity.desc: The player's estimated chance of winning at showdown against the players still in the hand, by random run-outs

pot.desc: Chips in the pot, bets of this round included

current_bet.desc: The highest bet of this round so far; 0 when nobody has bet

to_call.desc: Chips the player must add to stay in; 0 when checking is possible

pot_odds.desc: to_call divided by the pot after calling: the share of the pot the call costs, which the chance of winning must beat

can_check.desc: Whether nothing is to call, so the player may check

can_raise.desc: Whether a raise is possible: chips beyond the call, and the round not yet capped

raises.desc: Bets and raises made this round before the player's turn; 0 when nobody has bet (preflop, the blinds are not counted)

stack.desc: The player's chips behind, not counting what they already bet this round

min_raise.desc: The smallest total bet a raise may be made to

max_raise.desc: The largest total bet the player can make: all in

players_in_hand.desc: Players still in the hand, the player included

players_after.desc: Players still to act after the player in this round

random.desc: A random number drawn for this decision, so a strategy can mix its play (bluff some of the time)
